messages:
Sofia Grant: quick problem: webinar registrants are getting held up by enrichment and we miss the 1st-touch sweet spot (~5-9m lag). need a fast-path for event leads.
Max Rivera: agreed. proposal: immediate handoff to 'webinar-sdr' with minimal attrs, enrichment writes back as a PATCH that does NOT reassign owner. SLA target: 6m accept window for the event queue.
Tara Desai: on the HubSpot side we can add query param quick_route=true and meta owner_policy=preserve. Workflow: if quick_route -> RR to webinar-sdr; set lead.partial_profile=true.
Owen Park: important: Salesforce connector must honor preserve_owner to avoid SF automation stealing assignment. I'll add preserve_owner=true in the upsert and a unit test.
Sofia Grant: fallback if no accept in 6m?
Max Rivera: escalate to overflow-sdr and post automated note: "auto-escalated after 6m no accept". Also add an SLA tag so we can filter reports.
Tara Desai: canary plan: header x-rollout=canary, start at 4% traffic, monitor for 45m. Metrics: acceptance_rate, median_accept_ms, owner_flip_count, conversion_24h. Alert if median_accept_ms > 360000 or acceptance_rate < 65%.
ops-bot: webhook smoke OK (200). sample payload: {"email":"attendee@org.com","campaign":"q2-masterclass","quick_route":"true","x-rollout":"canary"}
Owen Park: enrichment job will PATCH fields: title, company_size, lead_score. It will NOT update owner unless owner==null. Sample patch: `PATCH /leads/:id {"lead_score":58,"company":"Acme"}`
Sofia Grant: SDR playbook (short): 1) call within 6m, 2) verify title & intent, 3) mark note "partial-profile follow-up", 4) if contact info missing, use backup-email flow. I'll drop the script in #marketing.
Max Rivera: observability: emit events lead.routed.webinar, lead.accepted.ms, lead.escalated.reason. Dashboards: rolling 30m window for acceptance_rate and owner_flip_ratio.
Tara Desai: after the event we'll run a perf check: delta in 24h conversion vs baseline, accept latency distribution, and % leads with owner changed post-enrichment.
Sofia Grant: timeline: implement hubspot flag + patch semantics today, canary tomorrow 0900, ramp to 20% after 2 hours if healthy. tagging @Owen for SF tests. :rocket:
